A balanced scales diagram illustrating the twin Bretton Woods institutions. On the left side, a blue building labeled 'IMF' with icons of currency symbols, representing short-term stability and exchange rates. On the right side, a green building labeled 'World Bank (IBRD)' with icons of a road, a hospital, and a school, representing long-term development and poverty reduction.

A map of West Africa with all 15 ECOWAS member countries highlighted in a unified green color against a white background. Arrows point from Nigeria outward to other West African nations to symbolize regional trade and the free movement of people. A small inset shows the ECOWAS logo. Clean flat textbook style.
